title: An Effective Criterion for Covering Maps Between Real Varieties
summary: We prove that a quasi-finite flat morphism with locally constant geometric-fiber cardinality between varieties over a real closed field induces a covering map on the rational points. The algebraic core of the criterion is a characteristic-zero result showing that every such morphism becomes finite étale after reduction. Since reduction does not change rational points, the induced map is a covering in the Euclidean topology.
